description.value:
You choose a tech power of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action, and that could target you. Casting this power also casts the chosen power, spending points for both, but the chosen power's effect is held in abeyance until a circumstance you specify while casting occurs; it then takes effect immediately, whether or not you still want it to, and this power ends.

The held power can affect only you, even if it would normally reach others. Casting this power again replaces any contingency already active on you, and the link breaks if your tech focus ever leaves your person.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
